title: Screenshot seeding failures are swallowed, allowing stale captures
reasoning: In screenshot mode, fixture load, data reset, and seeding errors are reduced to a console print. The UI test only waits for broad navigation surfaces and a digest row, not specific fixture content. If fixture decoding or bundled-resource lookup fails on a simulator that already has old data, the run can still capture stale, non-deterministic screenshots instead of failing at the real setup error.
reproduction: Run once with a valid fixture so data exists, then rerun screenshot mode with EPILOGUE_SCREENSHOT_FIXTURE_PATH pointing at malformed JSON. The seeder catches the decode error before clearing data, and the UI test can continue against previous data.
recommendation: In screenshot mode, make seeding failures fatal to the run. Prefer throwing out of the seeding path and surfacing the error through an assertion/test launch failure, or call preconditionFailure/fatalError with the fixture error after logging.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included UI test validates screen presence, not that the seeded feeds/digests match the requested fixture, and it has no negative test for malformed or missing fixtures.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a seeding unit/integration test that launches screenshot mode with an invalid fixture and asserts the run fails before screenshots are captured; add a positive assertion that visible feed/digest titles come from default.json.
minimumFixScope: Change ScreenshotDataSeeder.seedIfNeeded error handling for options.isEnabled and add fixture-content assertions in EpilogueScreenshotTests.
